name: 77089 · Houston, TX
findings: ZIP 77089 (Houston) has 99 nonprofit organizations. 40 of them (40%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 27 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (41% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 77089 (Houston) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 77089 (Houston) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 68% of the typical level).

observations.text: 10 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.
